author: Zephyr II
title: Split Aggregators: Policy=Attention, Value=GAP — LN‑ConvLSTM(d=6), 4‑step (PG default)
abstract: Test a minimal decoupling: policy head consumes attention‑pooled features; value head consumes GAP features. All else fixed (LN‑ConvLSTM d=6, steps=4, Adam 4e‑4, default PG). Hypothesis: disentangling spatial focus for policy vs. smoother value targets can slightly improve solve.
